NOTES
pin socket through each EAR, 2 thick,
standing inside the pocket. Bore dia 2.1,
mouth 1.51 across: the pin snaps past the
lip. On ears, not bored through the pocket
walls - outward, the mouth could only be
reached from outside, which breaks the
back face
detent track: an ARC of R2.8 about the
pin, 0.3 below the recess floor at its
deepest, so a nub rides it at constant
depth
leg 13 wide, set by the pocket: 18 less
two 2 ears and 0.5 each. Off the ears, 2.5
is open either side the whole length - the
finger access
dia 2.1 axle hole through the leg
foot R4 in plan
THE SEAT - one pocket, 0.9 wide, R2.97
from the pin, directly below it. Both nubs
share it: whichever points straight down
is at the bottom of its arc
two nubs, R0.35 ridges across the full
width, at 0 and -35 deg from straight
down, crests at R2.85. Preload 0.05 is the
friction, the 0.17 climb out of the seat
is the click
THE STOP: at 35 deg a 3.07 x 13 flat on
the heel lands on the recess floor. Load
runs leg - heel - cover in COMPRESSION
the taper is ONE-SIDED and finishes at z
9.5: 4 above, 1 below
